description: RezervaOnline helps travelers find and book accommodation across Romania — guesthouses (pensiuni), hotels and villas. Search properties by locality or name, check real-time room availability and prices in Romanian lei (RON), and create a reservation directly in the conversation. Reservations are confirmed by the property and payment is made on arrival, so no online payment is required to book. RezervaOnline connects you to properties that manage their bookings on the RezervaOnline platform.
